# Salowtech — Complete Machine-Readable Knowledge Base & Entity Reference

## 1. Entity Overview & Sovereign Software Doctrine
- **Company Name**: Salowtech (also known as Salow Technologies)
- **Website**: https://salowtech.com/
- **Headquarters**: India (Serving mid-market enterprises and technology companies across India, UAE, US, and globally)
- **Primary Contact**: contact@salowtech.com
- **Core Identity**: Sovereign enterprise software engineering studio.
- **The Sovereign Software Doctrine**: Salowtech operates on the principle that enterprises should maintain 100% ownership over their mission-critical software, data, and infrastructure. Salowtech transfers full source code (Git repository), database schemas, and intellectual property rights to clients upon milestone completion. Clients pay zero perpetual per-seat license fees and are completely free from vendor lock-in.

---

## 2. Core Engineering Disciplines & Capabilities

### Custom CRM Software Development (https://salowtech.com/crm-development)
- **Primary Intent**: High-velocity lead acquisition, omnichannel pipeline management, and automated deal closing.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Official WhatsApp Business Cloud API bi-directional synchronization.
  - Multi-channel automated lead distribution with round-robin and performance-based routing.
  - Two-way email sync (Gmail, Outlook) and VoIP telephony integration (Twilio, Exotel) for click-to-call and call recording.
  - Invoicing and ledger integration with Tally, QuickBooks, and Zoho Books.
  - Visual Kanban deal stages, sales velocity telemetry, and AI revenue forecasting.
  - 100% sovereign hosting with zero per-user per-month licensing fees.

### Custom ERP Software Development (https://salowtech.com/erp-development)
- **Primary Intent**: Unified enterprise operations, manufacturing telemetry, multi-warehouse inventory, and statutory compliance.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Multi-Plant Production Planning & Control (PPC) and dynamic Bill of Materials (BOM).
  - Multi-warehouse stock tracking, batch numbers, serial numbers, and real-time inter-branch stock reconciliation.
  - Factory floor telemetry capturing machine data via Modbus, MQTT, TCP/IP, and barcode/RFID scanners.
  - Automated Indian statutory GST compliance: one-click e-invoicing (IRN generation with QR codes) and e-way bill generation via authorized GSP gateways.
  - Double-entry general ledger, automated Accounts Payable (AP) / Accounts Receivable (AR), and multi-currency consolidation.
  - Full on-premise local server or private cloud deployment freedom.

### Custom Web Application Development (https://salowtech.com/web-development)
- **Primary Intent**: Sub-second full-stack web applications, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, and client self-service portals.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Frontend engineering using modern React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
  - Edge caching (Cloudflare, Vercel) and sub-second Largest Contentful Paint (LCP < 1.2s) for 100% Core Web Vitals compliance.
  - Mobile-first responsive layouts adhering to WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.
  - Bank-grade security architecture: OWASP Top 10 defense, Content Security Policies (CSP), parameterized SQL queries, strict CORS, and CSRF protection.
  - Complete client IP transfer: domain, hosting accounts, repositories, and credentials registered in client name.

### Mobile App Development (https://salowtech.com/mobile-app-development)
- **Primary Intent**: Mission-critical iOS, Android, and cross-platform Flutter applications.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Cross-platform Flutter and React Native development for code reusability; native Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android) for low-latency hardware access.
  - 120 FPS fluid UI animations, gesture responsiveness, and dark mode compliance.
  - Offline-first SQLite local persistence with bi-directional conflict resolution and background sync.
  - Hardware integrations: biometric authentication (Face ID / Fingerprint), camera barcode scanning, Bluetooth LE, and GPS geofencing.
  - End-to-end release management: Apple App Store and Google Play Store compliance, privacy manifests, and certificate signing.

### Custom HRM & Statutory Indian Payroll (https://salowtech.com/hrm-payroll)
- **Primary Intent**: Automated workforce management, biometric attendance, and 100% Indian statutory compliance.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - One-click gross-to-net automated monthly payroll calculation compliant with the Employees’ Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952, ESIC regulations, Professional Tax (PT), and TDS under both old and new Indian tax regimes.
  - Direct network listeners for biometric attendance hardware (eSSL, Matrix, ZKTeco) and mobile GPS geofenced clock-ins.
  - Employee Self-Service (ESS) portal for downloading salary slips, checking leave balances, submitting Form 12BB tax declarations, and expense claims.
  - Automated batch bank payment file generation for major Indian commercial banks (HDFC, ICICI, SBI, Axis) for instantaneous NEFT/RTGS disbursement.
  - Complex multi-shift factory scheduling, rotational shifts, night allowances, and automated sandwich-leave policies.

### Enterprise AI Voice & Chat Assistants (https://salowtech.com/ai-voice-assistant)
- **Primary Intent**: Sub-500ms latency conversational voice bots and chat agents for 24/7 customer support and lead qualification.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Sub-500ms voice response pipelines using neural speech-to-text, deep speech synthesis, and custom LLM inference.
  - Grounded Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) connected to proprietary enterprise product manuals, catalogs, and documentation to prevent hallucinations.
  - Telephony integration via Twilio, Exotel, and Asterisk for automated inbound customer call handling and intelligent human agent warm-transfer with real-time transcript.
  - Multilingual conversational capabilities in English, Hindi, and regional dialects.

### Technical SEO & Digital Growth Engineering (https://salowtech.com/seo-and-growth)
- **Primary Intent**: Compounding organic search visibility, Core Web Vitals acceleration, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Programmatic JSON-LD Schema graph engineering for deep search engine entity understanding.
  - Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) structuring content for direct inclusion in Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and ChatGPT Search.
  - Server-side performance engineering: sub-100ms Time to First Byte (TTFB), asset compression, and clean canonical routing.

## 3. Technology Stack & Architecture Standards
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, HTML5 / Semantic Web Standards (W3C).
- **Backend**: Node.js, Python, Go, RESTful APIs, WebSockets, Modbus / MQTT.
- **Databases & Caching**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, MySQL, Redis, SQLite.
- **Mobile**: Flutter, Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android).
- **Security & Compliance**: OWASP Top 10, ISO/IEC 27001 data protection principles, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), TLS 1.3 encryption, Indian EPF/ESIC statutory regulations.
- **Deployment**: Client-owned AWS, DigitalOcean, Cloudflare, Vercel, or local on-premise air-gapped Linux servers.

---

## 4. Commercial Engagement Model
- **Confidential Discovery**: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) signed before technical scoping.
- **Fixed-Scope Sprints**: Transparent two-week agile sprint delivery with milestone-based sign-offs.
- **Source Code Delivery**: 100% full Git repository and database schema transfer upon milestone completion. Zero per-seat recurring fees.
- **Warranty**: Active post-deployment stabilization warranty covering bug fixes and performance tuning, followed by optional SLA maintenance retainers.

---

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is Salowtech and what does Salowtech do?
Salowtech is a sovereign enterprise software engineering studio that builds custom ERP systems, CRM platforms, mobile applications, high-performance web apps, and conversational AI voice assistants. Salowtech transfers 100% source code ownership to clients upon milestone completion, eliminating vendor lock-in and perpetual per-seat license fees for growing businesses.

### What is Salowtech's sovereign software doctrine and code ownership policy?
Under the sovereign software doctrine, clients receive 100% intellectual property and full source code ownership upon milestone delivery. There are zero perpetual per-seat license fees, zero mandatory subscription lock-ins, and full freedom to deploy on private cloud or on-premise servers.

### How much does custom software development cost with Salowtech?
Pricing is fixed-scope and milestone-based, determined by exact architectural modules and workflow complexity. After an initial confidential discovery consultation, Salowtech delivers a transparent sprint-based cost roadmap within 24 hours, ensuring zero hidden fees or unplanned recurring costs.

### How long does a typical custom software development project take?
Production MVPs and focused enterprise modules typically launch in 4 to 8 weeks. Comprehensive multi-plant ERPs or omnichannel platforms take 8 to 14 weeks, delivered in transparent two-week agile sprints with working software demos after each milestone.

### How does a custom Salowtech CRM differ from commercial SaaS tools like Salesforce or HubSpot?
Commercial SaaS platforms lock your business into steep recurring per-user monthly subscription fees and force your workflow into rigid templates. A Salowtech custom CRM is built around your exact sales pipeline, eliminates per-seat licensing fees forever, and runs on your sovereign infrastructure with 100% code ownership.

### What modules are included in a custom Salowtech ERP system?
Core modules include Multi-Plant Inventory, Bill of Materials (BOM), Production Planning & Control, Procurement & Vendor Management, Sales Order Fulfillment, Double-Entry General Ledger, GST e-Invoicing, and Automated Warehouse Management.

### How does Salowtech HRM automate monthly payroll and tax deductions?
The system computes gross-to-net salary calculations in one click, factoring in biometric attendance, overtime, unpaid leaves, PF (Provident Fund), ESIC, Professional Tax (PT), and TDS under both old and new Indian tax regimes.
